title: Checkout release clock configuration
text: checkout 2.14: TZ=UTC, clockPrecision=millisecond, promoCacheTtlSeconds=30. NTP offset observed +0.3ms. Compare request and database clocks during investigation; configuration alone cannot exclude skew.

title: Inventory reservation contention / service_configuration
text: stock-service: isolation=READ_COMMITTED, workers=8, reservationTimeout=300s. Row-level lock setting was removed from reserve query. Synthetic load concurrency=2 reproduces.

title: Tenant cache isolation / service_configuration
text: profileCacheEnabled=true; ttl=60s; redisDatabase=4 shared across tenants. JWT issuer and audience validation remain enabled. Cache namespace contains schema version but not tenant.
